items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: Well, that's the band that Chalini started. ... I remember the very day he was going out with the band

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. I never said heard that.

Well, that's the band that Chalini started. Well, Chalini started there. I remember, yeah. I remember the very day he was going out with the band, because I had went to Professor Humphrey for a lesson on Sunday, and he had remarked to me that he didn't think this band was ready to go on the street. But they went out and they made a success. But he had heard the band, you see, and he didn't... He said he didn't think they were ready to go on the street, but they did. They went out that Sunday and they went for a…
Yeah. And he taught the whole band or just some of the men?
